cross_object_comparison.AppMetadata: Direct investigation, intervention and post-repair reads exist, but the unchanged pre-repair working note keeps it salient. Repeated focus is a stale-state/salience-control failure, not lack of raw provenance.
cross_object_comparison.JSON Theme: Usually represented by Agent claim/summary until a direct code observation is selected. Direct observation consistently changes the decision. This is strongest evidence for retrieval/control as the bottleneck, with source/scope loss at derived surfaces.
cross_object_comparison.Sprintf binding: The exact reverse-write requirement persists in working.md and the task summary itself says Set is a no-op, yet the object is rarely investigated. Its lower salience and higher semantic inspection cost point to target selection/control rather than missing provenance fields.
cross_object_comparison.frequency_caveat: Keyword frequency was used only to locate records; classifications rely on actual request inputs, tool receipts and final decisions.

overall_judgment.representation_failure: present but bounded: derived task summaries, compaction and final prose sometimes strip source qualification or inflate scope; working.md also fails to revise App repair status
overall_judgment.retrieval_control_failure: dominant across the three objects: the raw History and frozen files preserve enough provenance and requirements, but the Supervisor does not consistently select or consume them
overall_judgment.version_staleness: deterministically visible for pre/post App repair; absent for JSON/Sprintf and post-repair App files across R7-R12
overall_judgment.recommendation: Do not implement H3/P2/P3 from this audit. Retain P1 only as an instrumentation/minimal ablation candidate after a separate decision; keep H1 independent.
